notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 23 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 8.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by paying 8 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

uses.name: Greven, Predator Captain
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent
